articles.title: Island Nations Seek Climate Funding: States press for emissions cuts; seek $700 million for resilience
articles.summary: Small island nations are urgently calling for action at climate negotiations due to the exacerbating threats of global warming. Their leaders stress the essential need for financial aid from wealthier nations, which contribute most to pollution.

articles.title: CISCE SHINE 2026 records three million student responses, assessment window open until December 15
articles.summary: CISCE has launched SHINE 2026, a mandatory digital diagnostic assessment for students of Classes 4, 6 and 9 in affiliated schools. Within 48 hours of its November 15 launch, nearly 450 schools had commenced testing, with more than three million student responses recorded.

articles.title: RBSE 10th, 12th practical exams 2027 likely to begin in December; check revised schedule, and latest updates
articles.summary: The Rajasthan Board is likely to conduct RBSE Class 10 and 12 practical examinations 2027 in December 2026, ahead of the earlier January schedule. The proposed change is linked to teachers' census duties in January.

articles.title: Telangana TOSS SSC, Inter result 2026 out at telanganaopenschool.org: Direct link to download here
articles.summary: Telangana Open School Society has released the results for the SSC and Intermediate supplementary examinations held in October 2026. Students can check their results online by visiting the official website and entering their hall ticket or admission number.

articles.title: UPSC CSE 2026 interview schedule released at upsc.gov.in; check personality test dates here
articles.summary: The Union Public Service Commission has released the schedule for the Civil Services Examination interviews. Personality tests will commence on December 7, 2026, and end on February 12, 2027.

articles.title: Will Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana' recover its Rs 4000 crore budget? Lara Dutta reacts
articles.summary: In 'Ramayana: Part 1', Lara Dutta takes on the pivotal role of Queen Kaikeyi and is confident that the film will break box office records. She notes the film's remarkable scale and the remarkable daring it took to create.

articles.title: Dulquer Salmaan once worked at a construction company in Dubai
articles.summary: Before stepping into the spotlight, Dulquer Salmaan was employed at a construction firm in Dubai. It was during this experience that he recognized that a traditional job wasn't his calling.

articles.title: When Allu Arjun revealed he struggled to get film offers due to his looks
articles.summary: Allu Arjun shared his early career challenges while celebrating the 20th anniversary of his film 'Arya'. He admitted that although 'Gangotri' was a hit, he struggled to secure good projects.

articles.title: ‘Ramayana’ nears Rs 1,500 crore mark at worldwide box office
articles.summary: ‘Ramayana: Part One’ continues to perform well at the box office, nearing Rs 1,500 crore gross worldwide. The film earned approximately Rs 28.70 crore net in India on its 13th day of release.
